Resources [...] Top agency analytics alternatives tend to share a few traits. They support white-label or strong white-label so you can show clients your brand, not the vendor’s. They connect to the data sources agencies actually use: Google Analytics, Search Console, Meta, LinkedIn, Google Ads, and often a CRM or SEO tool. They offer some form of client reporting—live dashboards or scheduled reports—without requiring heavy customisation. And their pricing is either transparent or at least understandable so you can plan. A tool that’s “top” for enterprise might be overkill for a 5-person agency; one that’s “top” for freelancers might lack multi-client and white-label. So “top” has to be relative to your size and needs. We spell this out in best agency analytics alternative and agency analytics [...] ## Pricing across the top alternatives

Top agency analytics alternatives don’t always have the same pricing model. Some charge per user, some per client, some per dashboard. To compare fairly, map your real scenario—e.g. 8 people, 15 clients, white-label on—and get the total cost for each. Watch for add-ons (white-label, extra sources, API) that aren’t in the base price. A free tier or trial is useful so you can test with real data. We break this down in agency analytics alternative pricing and agency analytics alternative free.
